meta.description: Pull pre-computed ortholog calls from OrthoDB, Ensembl Compara, OMA, KEGG Orthology and documented PANTHER/eggNOG routes through a small Python requests client, with guidance on confidence semantics and when to defect to de novo inference.
meta.performed_by: Independent final re-auditor agent, lane 2 (not the fixer, tooler or prior auditor)

scientific_integrity.detail: Live values match the services: TP53 mouse ENSMUSG00000059552 / Trp53, MARCHF1 ENSG00000145416, KEGG K04451 with 548 members. No fabricated confidence values.

practice_boundaries.detail: Database retrieval only; no diagnostic or prescriptive output.

methodological_ground.detail: Resource semantics are not conflated; OrthoDB group verification and 1:1 filtering are sound; a partial batch is now flagged.

code_usability.detail: All three examples exit 0 on the final bytes; remaining items are doc and labelling P2s.

functional_suitability.note: Compara, OrthoDB, OMA and KEGG helpers return correct live values; the route is fixed and batch_compara reports every symbol. An unknown symbol is labelled request failed.

reliability.note: Retry helper and per-symbol batch status reproduced on a local stub and live; the example flags a partial batch.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is about 190 lines; the decision matrix, per-resource reference and common-errors table partly repeat each other.

agent_usability.note: Decision matrix, OrthoDB full-text trap and group verification are clear; the SKILL.md batch snippet filters on type and would drop failed symbols silently, and the three statuses are documented only in the docstring and example.

human_usability.note: Clear tables; the eggNOG note now states the 403 and the TLS failure and keeps the unverified label.

security.note: No credentials, HTTPS, read-only public APIs; loopback stub only.

maintainability.note: Single client module; still no automated tests.

agent_specific.note: Specific trigger description, clear defection to de novo tools; PANTHER and eggNOG are documented but not wrapped.

key_strengths: OI-09, OI-10 and the eggNOG note are fixed and verified; OI-01 to OI-08 did not regress (whole-module stub, OrthoDB, OMA, KEGG and PANTHER reruns on the new bytes).
batch_compara returns one row per input symbol with a status and a fixed column set; the example reports partial batches, shown live under Ensembl read timeouts.
Retry and error behaviour reproduced on a local stub; Compara, OMA, OrthoDB and KEGG return consistent TP53 calls.

recommendations.title: OI-11 Batch statuses undocumented in SKILL.md; snippet drops failed symbols
recommendations.problem: The three batch_compara statuses appear only in the docstring and example. The SKILL.md snippet filters on type == ortholog_one2one, so a user copying it would lose failed and empty symbols silently, the gap OI-10 closed in the example.
recommendations.root_cause: The status column was added to the client and example but not to the SKILL.md snippet or prose.
recommendations.fix: Add one sentence naming the statuses and a status check (or a count of non-found symbols) to the SKILL.md snippet.

recommendations.title: OI-12 Unknown symbol reported as request failed
recommendations.problem: batch_compara(["TP53","NOTAGENE123"]) labels NOTAGENE123 request failed (HTTP 400 text in the error column); Ensembl returns 400 for an unrecognised symbol. A user may read it as a transient outage and retry.
recommendations.root_cause: All requests.RequestException classes share one status.
recommendations.fix: Document that a 400 in the error column means an unknown or renamed symbol (resolve_symbol first), or give 4xx its own status such as symbol not found.
